headline: China Coking Coal Futures Hit Three-Month Low Amid Recovering Supply
summary: Dalian coking coal futures dropped for the fourth consecutive session to 1,346 yuan ($201.90) per ton, reaching their lowest level since mid-August due to sluggish demand and recovering domestic supply.
why: Coking coal is a critical raw material for steelmaking, and price movements in Chinese futures reflect domestic industrial demand and supply dynamics in the global commodity markets.
